summary: Local mass-deletion safety alerts now use an urgent GNOME notification that opens the review directly.
changelog: Raises local mass-deletion safety alerts as urgent GNOME desktop notifications.
Opens the safety review directly when the notification or its Review Now action is selected.
Explains that synchronization is paused before the missing local files can be deleted from Nextcloud.
Clears the desktop notification after the user approves the deletions, starts protected recovery, or removes the account.
Keeps mass-deletion protection scoped to local changes before they are propagated to the server.
